# ApproxBases { #deep_tensor.ApproxBases }

```python
ApproxBases(self, bases: Basis1D | List[Basis1D], dim: int)
```

An object that contains a polynomial basis in each dimension, 
used to construct a FTT approximation.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**bases**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Basis1D \| List\[Basis1D\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A single set of basis functions (to be used in all dimensions), or a list of basis functions to be used in each dimension.

<code>[**dim**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The dimension of the function being approximated.
